facts.business: Nakoda Group of Industries Limited is engaged in manufacturing and trading of food and agro-based products including Tutti Fruity, Karonda Cherries, fruit peels, jams, fruit pulp, sauces, canned and frozen fruits & vegetables, dry fruits, roasted nuts, popcorns, sesame seeds, spices, fox nuts, cotton, chia seeds, sabja seeds, amla products, gulkand, inverted sugar syrup, and has expanded into beverages and packaged drinking water.
